blocks.etymology: First attested in 1648; borrowed from Medieval Latin validātus (“to validate”) (perhaps through Middle French valider), the perfect passive participle of validō (see -ate (verb-forming suffix)), from validus + -ō (verb-forming suffix). By surface analysis, valid + -ate.

senses.definition: To prove that something is true, correct, or acceptable after testing or checking.

examples.en: Scientists carried out further tests to validate their results.
examples.vi: Các nhà khoa học đã tiến hành thêm nhiều xét nghiệm để kiểm chứng kết quả.

examples.en: Hearing similar experiences helped validate my own feelings.
